description: React component for the ValidationPage, allowing users to trigger validation runs, fetch reports, and run quality gates via API calls.

methods.name: onTriggerValidation
methods.description: Handles triggering validation for a data asset, manages loading and error states.

methods.name: onGetReport
methods.description: Fetches validation report by ID, manages loading and error states.

methods.name: onRunQualityGates
methods.description: Runs quality gates check for a data asset, manages loading and error states.
